description: This file defines an asynchronous actor 'MicLevelMonitor' for monitoring microphone audio levels using AVFoundation, along with a SwiftUI View 'MicLevelBar' that visualizes the microphone level as a segmented bar. It manages audio input, calculates normalized audio levels, and provides start/stop controls for microphone level monitoring.

classes.name: MicLevelMonitor
classes.description: An actor that captures microphone audio input, calculates normalized levels, and updates a callback with the smoothed audio level.

classes.name: MicLevelBar
classes.description: A SwiftUI View displaying the microphone level as a segmented bar with color coding.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins microphone level monitoring, setting up AVAudioEngine and installing an audio tap.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops microphone level monitoring and cleans up the AVAudioEngine.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Updates the smoothed audio level and invokes the callback with the new level.

methods.name: normalizedLevel(from:)
methods.description: Calculates a normalized audio level in the range 0-1 from an AVAudioPCMBuffer.

methods.name: segmentColor(for:)
methods.description: Determines the color of a segment in the mic level bar based on its index.
